due_when.clears_when: (1) `tp_geometry` is DEFINED in the matrix's `legend` alongside the status values, including what an ABSENT value means — and absence must be given an explicit name (e.g. `unrecorded`) rather than left as null, so 'we did not look' is sayable. (2) Cells whose evidence post-dates the 2026-08-10 cutover AND whose ref names a live-parity run are stamped `live_parity`; cells whose ref predates it are stamped `no_take_profit`. Where the ref does not establish either, the cell is stamped `unrecorded` — NOT guessed from the date alone, since a date is a proxy and this row exists because a proxy was trusted. (3) A guard asserts that every cell carries one of the defined values, so a new cell cannot be added silent. It must ship with a planted-omission self-test. (4) The roll-up reports geometry coverage as a fraction the way `rCoverage`/`pnlCoverage` do, so a reader sees the denominator instead of inferring completeness from the marked cells.
